description.value: The Pitt Meadows Family Recreation Centre is a municipal leisure facility operated by the City of Pitt Meadows, offering programs including a fitness centre, gymnasium sports, public skating, and an outdoor swimming and spray park. It functions as the primary community recreation hub for the city and draws a broad range of residents across age groups. Touring cyclists moving through the Lower Mainland and Fraser Valley area may find it a convenient midpoint stop, though specific cyclist amenities are not confirmed.
